fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Welcome to Precision Dental. We are a general and cosmetic dental practice in Fortitude Valley, caring for individuals, couples and families across inner Brisbane. From your first phone call to your final review, our aim is simple: to give you clear information, a calm experience and dental care planned around you.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Tucked inside HQ South Tower on Wickham Street, Precision Dental is a welcoming, modern practice in the heart of Fortitude Valley. We look after locals, families and people who work across inner Brisbane, with many patients joining us from neighbouring Newstead, New Farm, Teneriffe, Bowen Hills and Spring Hill.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We have shaped our practice around how people really feel about visiting the dentist. From the moment you arrive, our team is here to make your visit relaxed, unhurried and easy to fit into your week.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We believe you deserve straightforward information about your oral health. We explain what we find, show you images from our intra-oral camera where helpful, outline your options and discuss expected costs before treatment begins. There is never any pressure to proceed.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Many people feel uneasy about dental visits, and we take that seriously. Our team works gently and at a pace that suits you, and we offer happy gas for patients who would like extra support to relax during treatment.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Your care is tailored to your individual needs. We invest in dental technology such as digital X-rays, a digital OPG, 3D intra-oral scanning and CEREC to support accurate diagnosis and careful clinical work.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We are open five days a week, with appointments until 7pm on Tuesdays and from 8am on Fridays. Free on-site parking, on-the-spot health fund claims through HICAPS and payment plans through DentiCare help make your visit as easy as possible.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: As an accredited practice, we follow rigorous infection prevention and control protocols, with thorough cleaning between patients and sterilisation of reusable instruments.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Yes. We welcome new patients of all ages, from young children through to older adults. You can book online at any time or call our team during opening hours.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Where are you located, and is parking available?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: You will find us at {{site:addressStreet}}, Fortitude Valley. Free on-site parking is available for patients for the duration of their appointment.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We are open Monday, Wednesday and Thursday from 9am to 6pm, Tuesday from 10am to 7pm and Friday from 8am to 5pm. We are closed on weekends.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Yes. We keep time available for urgent care and will do our best to see you on the day you contact us. If you have severe facial swelling affecting your breathing or swallowing, please call 000 or go to your nearest hospital emergency department.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can I claim through my health fund?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We accept most major health funds and process claims on the spot using HICAPS. We are also a preferred provider for {{site:preferredFunds}}. Your rebate will depend on your fund and level of cover.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: I feel nervous about the dentist. Can you help?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Absolutely. Let us know when you book, and we will allow extra time for your visit. We explain each step before we begin, agree on a signal you can use to pause, and offer happy gas for patients who would like additional support.
